To: repo:objectstack#1
Request: PR #34910 (handed over from seat 3) · do not edit a landed changeset · 2026-11-18T04:08Z

The Version PR #33849 has gone `dirty` twice today on modify/delete conflicts. Each time, a PR edited a changeset that had already landed on `main` and that the Version PR had consumed: #35060 edited `34686-initialize-selection-rule.md`, and #35089 edited `34672-summary-readonly-on-update.md`.

A scan of all open PRs finds exactly one more that would do it: **#34910** modifies `.changeset/34441-shipped-base-canonical-member-one-answer.md`, which the Version PR consumes. Before #34910 is readied, please **revert that edit and add a new changeset of its own** describing its change. The maintainer is about to cut 18.6.0, and an edit there would break the Version PR a third time.
